name: io.at01.api/lookup
title: Lookup: India PIN codes and districts, public holidays
description: India PIN and place to district; US, UK, AU, CA holidays (not every region has every year).

tools.name: lookup_pin
tools.description: Look up an Indian six-digit PIN code: the post offices that use it (with India Post taluk), the state, and the district (the current district from the Local Government Directory where it can be matched safely by Census 2011 code, otherwise India Post's own label, which says which). Source: India Post office list via GeoNames (CC BY 4.0) and the Local Government Directory (GODL). Post offices change: it is a snapshot.

tools.name: lookup_place
tools.description: Which district is an Indian town or locality in? Returns matches with district, state, the basis (a town page with a Local Government Directory district, or India Post's label that the directory does not confirm) and a link to the page. About 19,000 towns and localities; old names such as Bangalore or Gurgaon resolve. Source: India Post via GeoNames (CC BY 4.0) and the Local Government Directory (GODL).

state.description: Optional state name to narrow the match, e.g. "Andhra Pradesh".

tools.name: holidays_on
tools.description: Public holidays for the US (federal), GB (England and Wales, Scotland, Northern Ireland), AU (states and territories) or CA (federal and provinces) for 2026 to 2028. Give a date (YYYY-MM-DD) or a year, and optionally a region such as NSW, Scotland or ON. A date also matches a holiday's legal date (flagged match "legal_date") when the day off is observed on another day. Not every region has every year: a region-year with no data returns status no_data, not "no holiday". Sources: US OPM, GOV.UK (OGL v3.0), Australian and Canadian government pages named in each row.

region.description: Optional region, e.g. NSW, Scotland, ON.

tools.name: next_holiday
tools.description: The next public holiday day on or after a date (default today, UTC) for the US, GB, AU or CA, optionally in one region. Same data and sources as holidays_on.
